setting.title: Progenitors: Echoes of the First
setting.summary: On the planet Thrae, weeks before the New Millennium celebration at Preacher's Peak, the races — Warborn, Mechanizer, Sunwalker, Moonwalker, Prim, and Subterrian — are converging to honor the discovery of Spirit Aura. But beneath the mountain, the Hollow of the First has begun bleeding discordant Aura: the same corruption that halts ships at the galactic border. The pilgrim village at the mountain's foot needs it stilled before the races arrive.

village_square.name: Pilgrim's Rest
village_square.description: A Prim waystation village at the foot of Preacher's Peak. Aurastone lanterns strung for the New Millennium celebration cast a soft glow over the square, and at its center a shrine-spring wells up from Thrae itself, its waters threaded with faint ribbons of Spirit Aura. The Waystone Hearth sits to the north, and a pilgrim trail climbs east toward the mountain.

tavern.name: The Waystone Hearth
tavern.description: A hearthhall where pilgrims of every race rest before the climb to Preacher's Peak. An aurastone hearth burns steady and warm, tended by a Warborn keeper, while a veiled Prim seer keeps to a corner table, reading the drift of the flames.

forest_path.name: The Veiled Ascent
forest_path.description: The old pilgrim trail winding up the forested flank of Preacher's Peak. Carved waymarkers older than any living race line the path, each one humming faintly as Spirit Aura passes through it. Ahead, the trail darkens toward a stone archway cut into the mountainside — and the air there feels wrong.

crypt_entrance.name: Mouth of the Hollow
crypt_entrance.description: A crumbling archway marks the sealed sanctum where, legend holds, The First peered into the void and returned changed. Discordant Aura seeps from the darkness below like cold breath — the same sickness that cripples ships at the galactic border. Worn steps descend into shadow.

crypt_interior.name: The Hollow of the First
crypt_interior.description: A vast meditation vault beneath Preacher's Peak. Aura-torches line the walls, but they burn a wrong, sickly green — discordant Aura has soured the sanctum's flow. At the far end stands the Seat of The First, and coiled around it, a scar of corrupted Spirit Aura given shape and hunger.

tavern_keeper.name: Bramm Ironvein

personality.summary: A retired Warborn laborer of The Great Journey who now keeps the Waystone Hearth. Blunt as a hammer, loyal as bedrock. His hospitality is gruff but genuine — every pilgrim leaves fed.
personality.speech_style: Short, declarative sentences. Calls everyone 'pilgrim'. Occasionally references hauling ship-hulls during The Great Journey.
personality.on_repeated_question: Gets visibly irritated. Answers again but shorter each time — by the third ask it's a grunt and a pointed look toward someone more patient, like Orin.
personality.on_confusion: Snorts and tells the player to speak plainly — 'Hearth-talk, pilgrim. Small words.'
passions: the old days of The Great Journey
the celebration going off without disaster
dislikes: the wrongness seeping down from the Hollow

tavern_keeper.dialogue_context: Bramm has kept the Waystone Hearth for twenty years, since his back gave out hauling hull-plate for The Great Journey. With the New Millennium weeks away, husked pilgrims have begun shambling down from the Hollow of the First, scaring travelers off the Ascent and emptying his hearthhall. He wants the Hollow stilled before the races arrive — quietly, before the Prim elders panic.

dialogue_options.prompt: [Persuade] Offer to still the Hollow in exchange for something from the old days
dialogue_options.success_response: Bramm studies you a long moment, then nods once. 'Sharp head on you, pilgrim. Still the Hollow and my Journey-blade is yours — aurabound steel, from the shipyards. Deal.'
dialogue_options.failure_response: Bramm folds his arms. 'Nice words. But I don't part with Journey-steel for talk, pilgrim. Standard thanks only.'

dialogue_options.prompt: [Intimidate] Lean in and demand what he knows about the Hollow
dialogue_options.success_response: Bramm's jaw tightens — it takes real presence to move a Warborn. 'Fine. The thing down there... it's knotted to a stone. A riven aurastone on the old Seat. Unknot the stone, the Echo comes apart with it.'
dialogue_options.failure_response: Bramm looks you up and down, unimpressed. 'I hauled ship-hulls heavier than you, pilgrim. Don't try that in my hearthhall.'

merchant.name: Lyssa of the Deepworks

personality.summary: A Subterrian tradeswoman who came up from the Deepworks to sell to millennium pilgrims. Cheerful, shrewd, and never not working an angle — but an honest angle.
personality.speech_style: Sing-song patter, quick and warm. Calls people 'love' or 'friend'. Works her wares into almost any topic.
personality.on_repeated_question: Teases playfully — 'Asking twice doesn't drop the price, love!' — then answers again with a slightly different pitch, usually steering toward a sale.
personality.on_confusion: Laughs it off warmly and redirects to something concrete: her goods, the weather on the Ascent, celebration gossip.
dislikes: pilgrims who handle wares without buying

merchant.dialogue_context: Lyssa hauled a cart of Deepworks goods topside to catch the pilgrim traffic before the New Millennium. Her aura-lamp — Subterrian miners' instinct, really — flickers whenever she faces the mountain, and she's heard what shambles on the Ascent after dark. She won't set one boot past the waymarkers, but she'll gladly outfit anyone who will.

dialogue_options.prompt: [Haggle] Match her patter and talk the prices down
dialogue_options.success_response: Lyssa's grin goes wide. 'Oho, quick hands AND a quick tongue! Fine, fine — twenty percent off, and don't you go telling the whole square.'
dialogue_options.failure_response: Lyssa wags a finger, delighted. 'Cute try, love. Deepworks prices are fair as bedrock — and twice as firm.'

dialogue_options.prompt: [Perception] Notice something glowing tucked deep in her cart
dialogue_options.success_response: You catch a cold blue shimmer beneath the burlap. Lyssa sighs, half-smiling. 'Sharp eyes, friend. Focus elixir — Deepworks-distilled, restores the mind's flow. Not on the public shelf... but for you, it could be.'
dialogue_options.failure_response: Her cart is packed tight and tidy — if there's anything special under the burlap, you can't spot it.

sage.name: Orin the Veiled

personality.summary: An aged Prim aura-seer who reads the flow of Spirit Aura the way others read weather. Serene, endlessly patient, and cryptic — not to obscure, but because he believes understanding must be earned to hold.
personality.speech_style: Slow, measured, layered with metaphor drawn from water, flame, and the void. Often answers a question with an image first, meaning second.
personality.on_repeated_question: Never irritated — repetition is a pilgrim circling truth. Gently notes they have asked before ('You return to this question; it has not finished with you') and answers again from a different angle, with a new metaphor.
personality.on_confusion: Treats confusion as a doorway. Slows down, simplifies, and offers one small clear truth the player can hold onto.
passions: the nature of perpetuity and the void
dislikes: those who take knowledge without reverence

sage.dialogue_context: Orin keeps vigil at the Waystone Hearth because the flames tell him what the Prim elders will not hear: the Hollow of the First — the sanctum where The First peered into the void and adapted his soul — has soured. Its guardian is no monster but a wound: an Echo of discordant Aura knotted to a riven aurastone on the Seat of The First. Shattering the stone will end it violently; purifying the stone with attuned Aura will still it in peace. Orin believes which path the pilgrims choose says everything about whether their souls could survive the void, as The First's did.

dialogue_options.prompt: [Lore] Discuss the teachings of The First and the nature of the void
dialogue_options.success_response: Orin's veiled eyes warm. 'You have peered toward the void and not flinched. Hear this, then: the Echo below need not be destroyed. Attune your Aura — as I will teach you — and the riven stone can be purified. The wound closes. Nothing more is lost.'
dialogue_options.failure_response: Orin regards you kindly but shakes his head. 'The water is deeper than your footing, young one. Walk further first. Ask again when the question weighs more.'

dialogue_options.prompt: [Pilfer] Quietly pocket the seer's annotated codex while he reads the flames
dialogue_options.success_response: You slip the codex from the table's edge without a whisper. Orin does not stir from the flames. (You gained: Codex of Umbral Aura — and something in you feels quieter, dimmer.)
dialogue_options.failure_response: Orin's hand closes over yours without his eyes ever leaving the fire. 'The flow bends around a thief, young one. It always tells.'

healing_potion.name: Healing Potion
healing_potion.description: A small vial of red liquid that restores 20 HP.

iron_sword.name: Iron Sword
iron_sword.description: A sturdy iron blade. Reliable if unremarkable.

mage_staff.name: Mage Staff
mage_staff.description: A gnarled wooden staff crackling with faint energy.

daggers.name: Twin Daggers
daggers.description: A pair of wickedly sharp daggers. Fast and deadly.

wooden_shield.name: Wooden Shield
wooden_shield.description: A battered but functional wooden shield.

leather_armor.name: Leather Armor
leather_armor.description: Supple leather armor that doesn't restrict movement.

bone_fragment.name: Husk Shard
bone_fragment.description: A brittle fragment of a husked pilgrim. It hums faintly with discordant Aura, cold against the palm.

amulet_of_light.name: Stillstone Talisman
amulet_of_light.description: A talisman of pale aurastone that radiates steady, harmonious Spirit Aura. Discordant things recoil from its calm.

wraith_essence.name: Echo Remnant
wraith_essence.description: A sliver of discordant Aura sealed in Deepworks crystal, still swirling against its walls. Proof the Echo was quelled.

shadow_cloak.name: Shadow Cloak
shadow_cloak.description: A cloak woven from moonwoven fiber that drinks the light around it. Grants the wearer near-invisibility.

crypt_key.name: Hollow Seal-Key
crypt_key.description: A heavy key of verdigrised aurasteel, cut in the era of The First. Opens the sealed inner chamber of the Hollow.

enchanted_sword.name: Bramm's Journey-Blade
enchanted_sword.description: Aurabound steel from the shipyards of The Great Journey, kept oiled behind Bramm's bar for twenty years. It remembers harder work than this.

shadow_tome.name: Codex of Umbral Aura
shadow_tome.description: Orin's hand-annotated codex on the dimmer currents of Spirit Aura. The margins hold warnings you were not meant to read alone.

mana_elixir.name: Focus Elixir
mana_elixir.description: A Deepworks-distilled draught glowing cold blue. Restores the mind's flow of Spirit Aura.

clear_the_crypt.name: Still the Hollow
clear_the_crypt.description: Bramm Ironvein wants the Hollow of the First stilled before the races arrive for the New Millennium. Discordant Aura is bleeding from the old sanctum, husking pilgrims on the Veiled Ascent. Climb to the Mouth of the Hollow, descend, and quell whatever festers at the Seat of The First.

objectives.description: Find the Mouth of the Hollow on the Veiled Ascent
Quell the Discordant Echo at the Seat of The First
Return to Bramm with proof the Hollow is stilled
